risks.finding: Step 4 says freeze BN statistics without freezing weights, but freeze_bn_stats calls eval() and sets requires_grad=False on its parameters. Concept option 2 separately describes frozen statistics with trainable weights. Setting parameter flags alone does not express frozen running-stat buffers; main's feature-extraction call defaults freeze_bn=False and calls model.train().

Main also includes an empty-group fallback, max(epochs,1) scheduler bound and last_val return whereas docs uses T_max=epochs and returns model. Six stage groups in code are not the five-line generic recipe.
risks.translation_effect: Docs payload is kept exactly, without silently copying the main helper or reconciling return values.
